content: keytar 7.9.0 archived (last release 2022). @napi-rs/keyring 2.1.0 (keyring-rs binding, Entry.setPassword/getPassword/deletePassword, AsyncEntry; macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux secret-service then keyutils fallback; keyutils does not persist across reboot; native binaries via optionalDependencies for 12 targets). Headless Linux/WSL without secret-service is the weak spot; CLIs (Codex ~/.codex/auth.json, Claude Code) use 0600 files on Linux.
